comment: Scene-skip timestamps for the Profanity Filter Kodi add-on. Keys are LOWERCASE movie titles exactly as matched by the add-on (usually the movie filename without extension or year). Each entry is a list of {start, end} scene windows in one of these time formats: 'h:mm:ss', 'm:ss', or plain seconds. A 'default' key applies to every video. Edit freely; the add-on fetches this file automatically by URL at play time, so you never need to copy it to the TV.
